conf.description: Facility SNMP APC/NMC card-administration PowerNet-MIB trap direct route: decode already-varbind-named fields into ECS, per recommendations.direct.cribl (no vendor pack installed on this instance, so OID-name resolution is NOT performed - same gap as the sibling ups-trap/env-trap pipelines)

conf.comment: APC PowerNet-MIB traps for card-administration/security events (accessViolationConsole, accessViolationHTTP, passwordChange). Assumes the Cribl SNMP Trap source has already resolved varbinds to the MIB object names used as this work order's 'vendor' field names. No Cribl Trap Varbind Translation pack is installed on this instance, so snmpTrapOID is NOT resolved to a notification name - passed through raw as event.code, same gap as ups-trap/env-trap. The trap carries materially less than the syslog/event-log forms of this dataset - there is no dedicated account, source-address or outcome varbind - and per recommendations.direct.cribl the account/outcome extraction from mtrapargsString is an Elastic-side grok task, not attempted here.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, input-field assumption, and the OID-resolution + Cribl-vs-Elastic scope gaps

computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename: v1 agent-addr (hyphenated, bracket-read) fallback for observer.ip, and a v1/v2c-cleartext-community boolean instead of carrying the community string itself - same convention as ups-trap/env-trap
batch-rename the three clean 1:1 fields, including the OID-valued snmpTrapOID passed through raw (event.code - see gap)

tag event.dataset (no hyphen, shared with the syslog/csv-file routes' data stream) and event.provider (so this never double-counts against the syslog route for the same card); drop community entirely (never indexed) and agent-addr via the 'agent-*' glob since the literal hyphenated name is rejected by eval.remove
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
